lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Alright, sis. Since you had all the fun last time, why don't you sit this one out?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Already on it. I'll just hang out with Sixteen over here.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Now, are you trying to buy time? Or are you just looking to throw your life away?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: ...this did *not* go well for you last time.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Oh, I'm not the same Namekian you faced before.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Oh. Oh shit, are you talking metaphorically?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Because if not, I'm gonna start feelin' like a racist, because you look *exactly* the same.
Piccolo's yell becomes distant and fades out

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Huh. I'm feeling a whole lotta Piccolo right now. Either he's showing off...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Or he's fighting an Android! We have to go help him!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: No, Gohan! We have to wait for Vegeta and Trunks to come out of the Hypertonic Lion Tamer!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, how long do we have left?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: We've been here for twenty hours!? When!? I mean, how!?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: That's what makes it hyper-sonic, Gohan!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♫ Egao urutora zetto de ♫ (With a smile that’s Ultra-Z)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♫ Kyô mo ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~ ♫ (Even today is ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~)

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Man, he has been at this for, like, twenty hours.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: S'called "hyperbole", big guy. Also, I can't sense power levels. What's goin' on over there?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Ah! Y'know, Sixteen, yelling "dodge" is more distracting than helpful!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Aww, there's my sweet little half-breed grand-baby.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: So, how's the detonator coming along?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: It's coming. But did you look at Dr. Gero's notes?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: As it turns out, he only attributes model numbers to his successful projects.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: The crazy bastard was kidnapping dozens of orphaned teenagers and experimenting on them!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Oh, come now, ya can't kidnap an orphan. They weren't wanted in the first place.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: As a side, that's kinda brilliant.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Interesting that he set explosives in their chests like this, though.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Must've been a fail-safe, for in case they went rogue.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Dooh, he does that to strangers and it's fine; but I want to do it to my own children, and your mother gets all uppity!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: *Dad*, any more talk like that and you don't get to hold Trunks anymore.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Wouldn't be talking so mighty if you had a bomb in your chest...

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Too bad, Jolly Green Giant™. Looks like ya missed. Try again for a zeni?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Umm, I stopped dodging. Seriously, are you even trying to hit me?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: 'Oh, man! It's even got a cool name!'

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: You know something I don't get?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: YOU try to kill Goku and that's fine. WE try to kill Goku and suddenly, you get all uppity.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: True. But when I did it, it was for revenge. You're just doing it for shits and giggles.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: You live a few years in stasis with your creator repeating the words "Kill Goku" over and over again in your subconscious... then you can ride that high horse all day long.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Man, that is some *serious* power being thrown around.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Dammit! We shouldn't just sit here like a bunch of cowards! We need to help!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: And do what - get ragdolled again!? No, thank you.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey, he's actually got a point.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I mean, between the Super Saiyans, the Super Namekian, the Androids and whatever the hell Cell is...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey! I was on Namek, okay!? Shit got crazy! I got stabbed! And BLOWN UP!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: I've been stabbed and blown up, too! And dumped by the only girlfriend I ever had!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Same. But ya know the difference?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: When mine left, she took all my money.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: When yours left, she took all *her* money.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: ...Gonna need a Senzu for that one.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Not that his hasn't been fun and all, but I'm going to give you one last chance to tell us where Goku is.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Or I'm going to have to start taking this seriously.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Be a nice change of pace.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dad? Do you think Piccolo can win?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Why do you keep stopping short?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, Gohan, w-were you saying something?

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Sorry, hard to hear you over the baby. He sure does cry a lot.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Do you think he gets that from his monkey side?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Dad! No racism in front of Trunks!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Oh, come on, I'm using "monkey" unironically, here. D'I-I mean, mostly.

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: Y'know, it's kinda hard to enjoy my meal with yer brat screaming.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Where did you get that food?! You've already cleared out our kitchens!

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: Not the fridge in the basement.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: I don't HAVE a fridge in my...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: We effectively have a detonator for the Androids.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Ugh, my God! This is so dumb! This cannot get any dumber.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Agreed. Sure is a lot of not-killing Goku going on right now.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: You know what would fix that?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: A good old rousing round of killing Goku.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Yeah!? W-w-well at least I *slept* with Bulma!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Yeah? Well, unlike Vegeta, *you can't prove it*!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Can, too! W-we'll just ask her!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: 'You know, in hindsight, I'm so glad I'm here right now.'

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Never mind that. Listen, I have the detonator for the Androids.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: TWENTY-TWO HOURS!? WHEN!? I-I MEAN, HOW!?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Look, I'm on my way over; try not to die in the meantime.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Dammit, green man. You are hard to put down.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah. Not gonna lie. Actually beginning to enjoy myself here.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Yeah, I know, I'm bluffing. I'm kind of at my limit.'

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: You run pretty good for a fat man!

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: Why're you so mad!? They weren't even that good!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Most of those weren't even meant to be *eaten* that way!

segments.title: So Majestic
segments.quote: I have spotted a pelican. So majesti-- ... That is a big bird.

segments.title: Hypertonic Lion Tamer
segments.quote: We have to wait for Vegeta and Trunks to come out of the Hypertonic Lion Tamer! / That one was on purpose! / That's what makes it hyper-sonic, Gohan!

segments.title: Yelling "Dodge" Is More Distracting Than Helpful
segments.quote: Dodge. / Dodge wh--? ... Seriously, what the hell's a "Kami"? / It means "God". Now, bow.

segments.title: You Can't Kidnap an Orphan
segments.quote: Oh, come now, ya can't kidnap an orphan. They weren't wanted in the first place.

segments.title: HELLZONE GRENADE!
segments.quote: Umm, I stopped dodging. Seriously, are you even trying to hit me? / NO! ... shit. / HELLZONE GRENADE! / 'Oh, man! It's even got a cool name!'

segments.title: Nothing, Just... Nostalgia
segments.quote: YOU try to kill Goku and that's fine. WE try to kill Goku and suddenly, you get all uppity. ... Nothing, just... nostalgia.

segments.title: She Took All *Her* Money
segments.quote: When mine left, she took all my money. When yours left, she took all *her* money. / ...Gonna need a Senzu for that one.

segments.title: YOU CAN FLY!
segments.quote: 'Why are you back-flipping?' / 'To gain some distance!' / 'YOU CAN FLY!'

segments.title: Do You Think Piccolo Can Win?
segments.quote: No. ... But maybe... Then again... Although... / Why do you keep stopping short?

segments.title: Bulma: Kills 'Droids Dead
segments.quote: "Bulma: Kills 'droids dead." / Wait, are you breastfeeding? / Yeah. Why? / ...Awesome!

segments.title: Room for One Mooore?
segments.quote: What the f*ck is *that*!? / Hello, boys. Room for one mooore?
